description: Implement TokenVaultService with pluggable KMS backend (Task 9.1) and AuditService for security event logging (Task 9.2). The TokenVaultService wraps/unwraps connector tokens using envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM DEK encrypted by KMS KEK). Each unwrap operation is logged to audit_log.
steps: Create apps/api/src/token-vault/token-vault.service.ts implementing: wrap(connectedServiceId, plainToken) -> stores encrypted token (ciphertext + dekId) in ConnectedService record; unwrap(connectedServiceId, userId) -> decrypts and returns plain token, writes audit log entry
The wrap method should: call kms.encrypt(Buffer.from(plainToken)), update ConnectedService with accessTokenCt/refreshTokenCt and dekId

The unwrap method should: read ConnectedService record, call kms.decrypt(ciphertext, dekId), write AuditLog entry with action='token_unwrap', category='security', metadata={connectedServiceId, userId}, return plaintext
Add methods: wrapAccessToken, wrapRefreshToken, unwrapAccessToken, unwrapRefreshToken for convenience
Create apps/api/src/audit/audit.service.ts with methods: log(action, category, userId?, metadata?, ipAddress?) -> creates AuditLog record via Prisma. Categories: 'auth', 'security', 'data', 'admin'
Wire TokenVaultModule and AuditModule into AppModule

Create apps/api/src/token-vault/__tests__/token-vault.service.spec.ts testing: wrap stores encrypted data, unwrap returns original plaintext (round-trip), unwrap logs to audit, unwrap with missing DEK throws
Create apps/api/src/audit/__tests__/audit.service.spec.ts testing: log creates AuditLog record with correct fields
Run pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run lint, pnpm run build, pnpm run test
acceptance_criteria: TokenVaultService.wrap encrypts token and stores ciphertext + dekId in ConnectedService
TokenVaultService.unwrap decrypts and returns original token
Every unwrap call creates an AuditLog entry
AuditService.log creates entries in the audit_logs table
Round-trip test: wrap(token) then unwrap returns same token
All existing tests continue to pass
findings: Prisma Json type requires casting Record<string, unknown> to Prisma.InputJsonValue. All tests pass (29/29), typecheck clean, lint clean, build clean.
